correctness.rationale: For h=3,4 and n>=3, the three consecutive h-bit column transition condition L_h(a,b,c) is exactly the B3/S23 fixedness equation for the middle column; periodic closed walks of T_h therefore count all labelled fixed states, even at the smallest n=3. The actual height-four 256-state graph has 499 transitions and exactly one cyclic SCC of 127 vertices/309 edges; self-loop and strong connectivity make its adjacency B primitive. Exact symbolic 127-degree determinant plus rational positive vector v=B^4001 gives Collatz–Wielandt 2.55371542<λ<2.55371544<13/5. The height-three graph contains a 27-state cyclic component of exact characteristic polynomial x^24(x^3-27), giving F3(n)>=3^(n+1) at 3|n. Trace bound F4(n)<=127 λ^n, and integer 127*13^27<3*15^27 handles n>=27. Exact F4 for multiples n=3,6,...,24 are 39,651,5907,99107,1517719,24500451,391780043,6355667155, each below 3^(n+1). Independent local transfer construction reproduced 64-state/256-state graph edges 156/499 and traces F4(3)=39,F4(4)=53,F4(6)=651,F3(3)=127,F3(6)=2595. This is an all-n finite-spectral proof, not extrapolation.
